messages:
Maya: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #1984? small perf/cost change touching quantization path + routing heuristics. link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1984
Tom: on my queue, can you paste the short bench summary here? if gains are modest i might leave for monday.
Maya: sure — local microbench on rtx-a100: end-to-end throughput +13% on 8k context, p50 latency +4% (down). token cost model shows ~18% cost/token reduction for typical web-chat workload. main changes:
```
- use 4-bit dynamic quant path for small-batch serving
- switch kv_cache.policy from static-prefix to adaptive-window
- routing: prefer smallest compatible quantized variant for best cost under <100ms SLO
```
Oliver: nice. did you validate correctness on the 8 evaluation prompts? any regressions?
Maya: ran evaluation set (8 prompts + randomized ref) — small drop in exact-match on one structured output case (0.5% absolute). i added a fallback that forces full-precision for that prompt pattern by regex in routing.
Jen: can you show the routing rule? we should be careful with regexes at scale.
Maya: here it is:
```yaml
- match: "/^\\[META\\]/"
  route: full-precision-v2
  reason: preserve structured-tokenization
```
Tom: LGTM for the perf bits. Alex — can you eyeball the cache policy changes? we had regressions last time when windowing interacted with long-session batching.
Alex: will do in ~30m. also CI is green but we need a canary rollout plan. SRE-bot: automated check — canary baseline required for routing changes. :robot_face:
SRE-bot: canary checklist: deploy to canary pool (5%), monitor latency, error rate, and cost burn for 24h.
Maya: thanks. would like to merge before EOD if reviewers + canary plan ok — it's blocking a customer cost case.
Tom: if Alex approves and SRE signoff on canary plan, i'm fine to approve.
Oliver: i'll take a quick look at the fallback unit tests.
Alex: reviewed cache delta — minor comment inline about eviction window math, otherwise ok. left a suggestion.
Maya: fixed comment and pushed new commit. CI passed again.
Tom: approved. merging after you kick off canary?
Maya: starting canary now. will post updates in this thread. :eyes:
